name: e01-tremor
eval: window.__afterTeleport=()=>{const D=window.__DD__;const g=D.game;const p=g.player;window.__ev=g.progression.events.force('tremor',{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z,inCamp:false,busy:false,lit:true,depth:150-p.y});const ev=window.__ev; if(ev){const f=window.__fp; const t=ev.anchor; const dx=t[0]-f.x, dy=t[1]+0.8-f.y, dz=t[2]-f.z; f.yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz); f.pitch=Math.atan2(dy,Math.hypot(dx,dz));}};

name: e02-rockfall
eval: window.__afterTeleport=()=>{const D=window.__DD__;const g=D.game;const p=g.player;window.__ev=g.progression.events.force('rockfall',{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z,inCamp:false,busy:false,lit:true,depth:150-p.y});for(let k=0;k<70;k++)g.progression.events.update(1/30,{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z,inCamp:false,busy:false,lit:true,depth:150-p.y});window.__ev=null;const ev=window.__ev; if(ev){const f=window.__fp; const t=ev.anchor; const dx=t[0]-f.x, dy=t[1]+0.8-f.y, dz=t[2]-f.z; f.yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz); f.pitch=Math.atan2(dy,Math.hypot(dx,dz));}};

name: e04-echo
eval: window.__afterTeleport=()=>{const D=window.__DD__;const g=D.game;const p=g.player;window.__ev=g.progression.events.force('echo',{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z,inCamp:false,busy:false,lit:true,depth:150-p.y});for(let k=0;k<45;k++)g.progression.events.update(1/30,{x:p.x,y:p.y,z:p.z,inCamp:false,busy:false,lit:true,depth:150-p.y});window.__ev=window.__ev&&{anchor:g.progression.events.live.light||window.__ev.anchor};const ev=window.__ev; if(ev){const f=window.__fp; const t=ev.anchor; const dx=t[0]-f.x, dy=t[1]+0.8-f.y, dz=t[2]-f.z; f.yaw=Math.atan2(-dx,-dz); f.pitch=Math.atan2(dy,Math.hypot(dx,dz));}};
